name: Resale and flipping

not_yet: Don't buy in bulk before you've flipped 10 items.
Don't list on every site at once. Start with one.
Don't hold an item past 60 days. Drop the price and move it.
crowd.note: Inventory risk. Buy small and sell fast.
crowd.basis: research/crowd.json (our judgment); research/niches/resale.json has no sourced season.

rules: Genuine items only. No fakes, replicas or 'dupes', and never another brand's name on a look-alike.
Check recalls before you buy kids' items, baby gear and appliances. Selling a recalled product is illegal unless the recall fix was done, and the listing says so.
Skip cribs made before June 2011, wobbly or incomplete baby gear and kids' metal jewelry.
No fireworks, fuels, chemicals or other hazardous materials. Perfume, food, knives, tickets and gift cards have their own rules on each site.
Photograph and name every flaw. Undisclosed damage and 'not as described' are why buyers get refunds.

closet.label: Your own closet and garage
closet.how: Start with 10 things you own: no money at risk while you learn photos, titles and shipping.

thrift.label: Thrift stores
thrift.how: Go when new racks come out; check sold prices on your phone before you buy.

yard.label: Yard and garage sales
yard.how: Bring small bills; ask for a bundle price on several items.

estate.label: Estate sales
estate.when: Day 2 or the last day for discounts
estate.how: Look at the sale photos online first and go early for the best items.

marketplace.label: Local listings and free groups
marketplace.how: Look for underpriced and free items nearby; pick up in public places.

tax_note: eBay, Depop and Facebook charge their fee on the sales tax too. We use 7 percent tax, as in eBay's own fee example; your buyer's rate varies.

shipping.basis: USPS Ground Advantage commercial price for zone 5 (labels bought online), USPS Notice 123 effective October 4, 2026. Zones 1 to 9 run from about $1 less to about $4 more.

texts.watchers: Thanks for watching my {item}! I can do {price} with shipping as listed. Happy to answer any question about it.
texts.bundle: Bundle 2 or more of my items and I'll take {off} percent off, shipped together in one box.
texts.move: Day {day}: bundle it, take it local, or donate it and keep the receipt. Your cash is worth more than the shelf space.

keep.title: Thank-you and repeat buyers
keep.description: For every order: a thank-you note for the package, a message after delivery asking for an honest rating, and a bundle offer for their next order.
keep.card_footer: Small shop, real person. Every item checked and every flaw named.
rules: Ask every buyer the same way, not only the happy ones.
Never offer a discount or refund for a rating.

texts.thank_you: Hi {greet}, thank you for buying {done}! If anything isn't right, message me and I'll make it right.
texts.review_ask: Hi {greet}, your order shows delivered. I hope it's just what you wanted. An honest rating helps a small seller like me: {review_link}. And if you want anything else from my shop, message me first and I'll bundle it into one box.
texts.card_line: Thanks for buying from {business}. New finds go up every week. Message me before you buy two or more and I'll bundle them into one box.

rules: Take payment only through the site, or cash in person for local pickup.
Never share a code that was texted to you, and never use a payment link a buyer sends.
Don't ship until the sale shows as paid in the app.
Meet local buyers in a busy public place in daylight, and bring someone if you can.
Counter once, close to your lowest price. Offer a bundle before a bigger cut.
A hold needs a time. Until then, keep answering other buyers.

available.label: Is it available?
available.means: They want to know it is still for sale.
available.ship: Yes, it's still available! You can buy it right on the listing, and it ships within 1 business day with tracking.
available.local: Yes, it's still available! I can meet at {pickup}. What time works for you today or tomorrow?
available.next: Answer within the hour if you can, then point them to buy or set a time.

offer.label: An offer or "lowest?"
offer.accept_ship: Deal at {amount}! Send it as an offer on the listing and I will accept it right away.
offer.accept_local: Deal at {amount}, cash at pickup. I can meet at {pickup}. What time works for you?
offer.counter_ship: Thanks for the offer! The best I can do is {counter}, and it ships within 1 business day. If you add another of my items, I will take {bundle_off} percent off both. Want it at {counter}?
offer.counter_local: Thanks for the offer! The best I can do is {counter}, cash at pickup. Want it at that price?
offer.unknown: Thanks for the offer! Let me check what I can do, and I'll get back to you today.
offer.next: Counter once. If they say no, let it go: the next buyer may pay your price.
offer.lowest_ship: The lowest I can do is {counter}, and it ships within 1 business day. If you add another of my items, I will take {bundle_off} percent off both.
offer.lowest_local: The lowest I can do is {counter}, cash at pickup. When could you meet?

hold.label: Can you hold it?
hold.means: They want you to keep it for them.
hold.ship: I can't hold it without payment, but it's yours the moment you buy it on the listing. I ship within 1 business day.
hold.local: I can hold it until {hold_until} if we set a time now. After that it goes to the next person who asks. What time works for you?
hold.next: Hold only with a set time, and keep answering other buyers until they pay or show up.

late.label: Late or a new time
late.means: They're late or want another time.
late.answer: No problem. Can you confirm a new time today? I'll keep it for you until then, and after that it goes to the next person in line.
late.next: One new time only. If they miss it, move on to the next buyer.

no_show.label: They didn't show up
no_show.means: They didn't come to the pickup you agreed.
no_show.answer: Hi, I was at {pickup} at the time we agreed. Do you still want it? If I don't hear back today, it goes to the next person who asked.
no_show.next: Send this once. If they don't answer today, sell it to the next buyer and don't hold for them again.

authentic.label: Is it real?
authentic.means: They want to know it is genuine.
authentic.answer: Yes, it's genuine. The photos show the tags, labels and any serial number so you can check, and I'm happy to send more photos of anything you want to see.
authentic.next: Only send this if you are certain it is genuine. If you are not, say so, or take the listing down.
authentic.check: Only say this if you are certain the item is genuine.

sources.says: Counterfeit or fake items aren't allowed. You may list an item only if you're certain it's genuine.
Buyers have 72 hours after delivery to open a return case for an item that is not authentic or not as described.

question.label: A question about the item
question.answer: Good question! Let me check and send you a photo in a few minutes.
question.next: Answer with a photo or a measurement, never a guess.

other.label: Not sure what they meant
other.answer: Thanks for your message! It's still available. Is there anything you'd like to know or see?
other.next: Keep it short and end with one question.

scams.label: Asks for a code
scams.means: They asked for a code that was texted to you.
scams.why: With that code they can set up a phone number or get into an account in your name.

scams.label: Pay or talk outside the app
scams.means: They want to pay or talk outside the app.
scams.why: Sites protect only sales paid through their own checkout, and a payment-app payment can be faked or reversed.

scams.label: Overpayment or a check
scams.match: \b(cheques?|money orders?|cashier'?s checks?|certified checks?|personal checks?|business checks?|(a|the|my) check (for|of|in the)|(mail|send) (you )?a check)\b|\boverpa(y|id|ying)\b|\bextra (money|amount|for (the )?(shipping|mover|pickup|courier))|\bsend (back|the rest|the difference|me the difference)|\brefund the (difference|extra)
scams.means: They offer more than your price, or a check.
scams.why: The payment bounces later, and you lose the item and any money you sent back.

scams.label: Someone else picks up
scams.means: They want a courier or someone else to collect after paying some other way.
scams.why: This is how fake-payment and overpayment scams usually collect the item.

scams.label: A payment email or link
scams.match: \b(payment|paypal|zelle|bank) (email|notification|receipt|confirmation)\b|\bclick (the|this|on the) link\b|\bupgrade (your|to a) business account\b|\bpending (until|payment)\b|\bcheck your (email|spam)\b
scams.means: They point you to an email or link that says you were paid.
scams.why: Fake payment emails look real. Check your balance in the app itself, never through their link.

buyers.scam_ship: Thanks, but I only take payment through {site}, and I don't share codes or contact details. If you'd like it, you can buy it right on the listing.
buyers.scam_local: Thanks, but for local pickup I only take cash in person when we meet, and I don't share codes. If you'd like it, let me know a time today or tomorrow.
buyers.scam_next: Don't send anything else, don't click their links, and don't ship until the sale shows as paid in the app. Report the account on the site, and report the scam at ReportFraud.ftc.gov.

sources.says: Fake buyers send fake payment notices, 'overpay' and ask for the difference back, or ask for a verification code. Don't accept mobile payments from people you don't know, don't deposit a check for more than the price, and don't share codes.
Mercari doesn't protect transactions where payment is made outside the app or site, and asks users not to share contact or payment details.
